content: AeroSpace MacApp: one dedicated Thread per app (pid) running CFRunLoopRun; AXObservers added to that run loop; all AXUIElement access confined to that thread (ThreadGuardedValue). Main actor submits RunLoopJobs (cancellable) via perform(selector:on:thread). setFrame jobs per windowId are cancelled/replaced (latest wins). setFrame order size->position->size; temporarily disables AXEnhancedUserInterface. Refresh sessions are cancellable Tasks; new AX events cancel in-flight refresh. AeroSpace source contains no AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout; yabai sets AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout(systemWide, 1.0).
